push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 10.0 (top 10% MID)
push.body:
BellyTb1, I've seen sunsets in Kansas less beautiful than that 10.0. Top 10% for a midfielder.

DID WELL
+ 31 passes (up from your usual 20). You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu.
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football.
+ A hat trick against Da1e FC, your 2nd straight match scoring. That ball had your name on it from the moment you set your feet.
+ Man of the Match, your 5th for us. Put that one on the fridge.
+ PhogsToffees scored and you helped make it happen. Keep feeding those runs.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- 64% passing (20 of 31, down from your usual 73%). If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.
- Lost 4-5 to Da1e FC. Be a goldfish about the score, hang onto the lessons.

Five minutes of this: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

I'm gonna go tell my plant about you. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 4-5 vs Da1e FC | You: 9.6 (top 10% FOR)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, that 9.6 is the kind of night that makes an old coach believe in magic. Top 10% of forwards.

DID WELL
+ 4 shots at Da1e FC's goal. The keeper's arms are probably still sore.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 2). That's the kind of vision you can't teach. Well, I can try, but you already have it.
+ A goal against Da1e FC, your 3rd straight match scoring. Never gets old, and I hope it never does.
+ You found BellyTb1 and BellyTb1 found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ 1.8 better than usual. That's a staircase, and you're climbing it.

WORK ON
- 1 of 4 shots on target. Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.
- Pass accuracy: 78%. Decent, but top-quarter forwards get to 88%+. That's the next rung.
- Fell to Da1e FC, 4-5. Tomorrow's a clean slate and we've got chalk.

Training-ground special: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso
